summary: Modularize communication conformance and harden strict JSON, calendar, enum, and symlink validation

delivery.outcome: Modularize docs/communication/conformance.py (<500 lines per module) and harden communication and standard conformance suites against bool-as-int, invalid calendar timestamps, unknown enum bypasses, unhashable TypeErrors, duplicate JSON keys, and symlinks.
nonGoals: No breaking wire schema changes to published v1/v2 schemas or profile digests

architecture.decision: Extract shared primitives and POA runtime-event validator into docs/communication/runtime_conformance.py while keeping delegation, MCP, CLI, and re-exports in docs/communication/conformance.py (<400L each), and harden docs/standard/conformance.py.
architecture.rollback: Revert modularization and hardening commit on docs/communication and docs/standard.

validation.evidence: All conformance checks, unit tests, ruff checks, governance-check.sh, and wellman check pass with 0 errors.
